mismatches: The screw holes are not centered at y=0; they appear to be offset towards the negative Y direction (the center of the cylindrical faces is at y=1.75, while the part width is 30mm from y=0 to y=30).
The screw hole axes are along the Y axis, not the X axis as specified in R3.
The mass is 119.34g, which violates requirement R7 (mass <= 90g).
The part does not feature a tapered profile as described in the design document; it appears to be a constant rectangular cross-section for the arm.
gate.summary: The rendered part fails multiple requirements, including mass limits, screw hole orientation/placement, and the intended tapered geometry.

mismatches: The screw holes (R3) are completely missing from the rendered part.
The design document specifies the arm width tapers towards the tip, but the render shows a constant width for the horizontal arm.
gate.summary: The rendered bracket is missing the required screw holes and does not exhibit the intended tapered profile for mass optimization.

mismatches: The screw access channels (rectangular cutouts) are visible on the side of the spine, but they do not appear to extend through the entire width/depth as required for screwdriver access from the front.
The design document specifies a tapered profile for the arm to reduce mass, but the rendered part shows an arm with a constant width along its entire length.
gate.summary: The part follows the general L-shape geometry and dimensions, but fails to implement the specified tapering of the shelf arm and the screwdriver access channels are not clearly executed as described.

gate.summary: The part fails to meet the height constraint (R4) by extending above z=110 and appears to lack the required screwdriver access cutouts for the screw holes (R3).

mismatches: The Z-dimension (height) of the part reaches 216 mm according to the bbox and Front view, which violates R2 (max z=130) and R4 (no material above z=110).
The shelf arm is not horizontal; it is angled upwards in the isometric and front views, violating R4.
The vertical spine does not appear to be a rectangular block as specified; it has an irregular shape or orientation that doesn't match the design document.
systemic: The part is designed with an upward-sloping arm, which makes it impossible to support a horizontal shelf as required by R4.
gate.summary: The rendered part fails significantly on dimensional constraints (Z-height) and geometry requirements, specifically providing an angled arm instead of the required horizontal shelf support.
